title: Detailed book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book cover -->
  <rect x="18" y="15" width="64" height="72" rx="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- Book cover lighter edge (spine side) -->
  <rect x="18" y="15" width="8" height="72" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- Pages block -->
  <rect x="26" y="19" width="52" height="64" rx="1" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="31" y1="28" x2="73" y2="28" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="34" x2="73" y2="34" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="40" x2="73" y2="40" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="46" x2="73" y2="46" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="52" x2="73" y2="52" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="58" x2="65" y2="58" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="64" x2="73" y2="64" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="70" x2="60" y2="70" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Center fold line -->
  <line x1="52" y1="19" x2="52" y2="83" stroke="#E8D8B8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d="M52 15 L52 45 L48 41 L44 45 L44 15" fill="#DC143C"/>
  <!-- Book cover decoration - gold diamond -->
  <polygon points="50,4 56,10 50,16 44,10" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Gold corner accents -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="19" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="19" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="83" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="83" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Book title area on cover -->
  <rect x="30" y="87" width="40" height="0" fill="none"/>
</svg>
